verdict.rationale: Lindy's docs describe building automations via skills and routines that run without writing code (lindy-docs-6, lindy-docs-18, lindy-docs-19), which supports no-code workflow creation, but there is no evidence in the pack of an actual visual/drag-and-drop editor, canvas, or flowchart-style builder for multi-step workflows. Missing for 10: explicit visual editor/canvas documentation, screenshots or descriptions of node-based flow construction, and confirmation of visually chaining multiple steps rather than describing them in natural language.
